about.mission: To foster inclusive learning, sharing, and collaboration among Kenya's technical writers, developers, and documentation enthusiasts.
about.vision: To be a leading hub for documentation excellence in Africa, connecting local talent with global opportunities.
about.description: Write the Docs Kenya is part of the global Write the Docs network, dedicated to building better documentation practices and connecting professionals across the documentation ecosystem.
